faqs.question: 1. Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is designed as an all-inclusive luxury yacht experience. The fare includes accommodations, dining, selected premium beverages, Wi-Fi, onboard gratuities, entertainment and marina-style watersports. Certain experiences and personal expenses remain additional.

faqs.question: 2. Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection include food?
faqs.answer: Yes. Meals at the included dining venues are covered by the cruise fare, along with 24-hour in-suite dining.

faqs.question: 3. Are drinks included on Ritz-Carlton yachts?
faqs.answer: Yes. A selection of premium wines, spirits, cocktails, beers, mocktails, specialty coffees, teas and other beverages is included. Certain private-reserve or premium items can cost extra.

faqs.question: 4. Is Wi-Fi included on Ritz-Carlton yachts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Starlink Wi-Fi is included with the cruise fare.

faqs.question: 5. Are gratuities included on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?
faqs.answer: Yes. Standard onboard gratuities for the yacht's restaurant, bar and housekeeping services are included.

faqs.question: 6. Are excursions included on Ritz-Carlton yachts?
faqs.answer: No. Shore excursions are generally additional. Travelers can choose from organized experiences or more personalized private excursions.

faqs.question: 7. Is specialty dining included?
faqs.answer: Most dining is included, but selected specialty restaurants carry an additional charge. These currently include S.E.A., Seta su Ilma and Seta su Luminara.

faqs.question: 8. Is room service included on Ritz-Carlton yachts?
9. Are spa treatments included?
faqs.answer: No. Spa treatments such as massages and facials generally carry an additional charge.

faqs.question: 10. Are airport transfers included?
faqs.answer: Not automatically. Transfers can be arranged separately and may carry an additional charge unless specifically included in a package or promotion.

faqs.question: 11. Are hotels included in the Ritz-Carlton yacht fare?
faqs.answer: No. Pre- and post-cruise hotel accommodations are generally separate.

faqs.question: 12. Is airfare included?
faqs.answer: No. Airfare is generally separate from the cruise fare.

faqs.question: 13. Is laundry included?
faqs.answer: Self-service laundry facilities are available at no additional cost. Professional laundry and dry-cleaning services can carry an additional charge.

faqs.question: 14. Are watersports included?
faqs.answer: Access to the yacht's marina-style watersports is included, subject to operational, weather and local conditions.

faqs.question: 15. Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection include everything?
faqs.answer: No. It is an all-inclusive luxury yacht experience, but airfare, hotels, transfers, shore excursions, spa and salon services, selected specialty dining, certain premium purchases and other personal expenses can be additional.
